chars.K: KHADIJA: a 25-year-old Moroccan woman wearing a burgundy headscarf, a cream knitted cardigan and dark blue jeans.
chars.J: JULIEN: a 45-year-old French man with a thick grey moustache, wearing a grey flat cap, a red plaid flannel shirt and beige chinos.
chars.M: MOM: a Moroccan mother wearing a lavender djellaba and a white headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA sits on her bed in a modest bedroom in Meknes at night, holding her phone in a video call; on the phone screen JULIEN smiles and waves. She looks surprised and excited.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: JULIEN sits in a small French apartment with a window showing grey Paris rooftops, talking into his phone with a big confident smile, hand on his chest making a promise.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: JULIEN walks out of Marrakech Menara airport arrivals with a small suitcase, sunglasses pushed up, looking around eagerly; palm trees outside.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: JULIEN stands alone in a dim narrow medina alley in Marrakech at dusk, half in shadow, glancing over his shoulder suspiciously. Mysterious tense mood.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA in her bedroom in Meknes on the phone, panicking, one hand raised saying no, eyes wide, glancing at her closed bedroom door.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: JULIEN at his laptop booking a hotel, a picture of a Marrakech riad hotel with a pool on the laptop screen (no text), credit card in hand, smiling slyly.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA sits by her window in Meknes typing on her phone, worried and hesitant, biting her lip, evening light.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA with a travel bag on her shoulder walks out of the front door of a Meknes house; MOM stands in the doorway waving goodbye, unaware and smiling. A taxi waits in the street.
